details: Published DEB, RPM, AppImage, and Pacman packages from source commit 76de9782. The release adds a write watchdog that ends stalled radio operations, treats malformed or out-of-range tone fields as no tone without rewriting them on DM-32UV, RT-950, and UV-17ProGPS images, and retries the UV-32/UV-5RM Plus handshake. It carries the latest Android USB and proxy broken-pipe triage plus all intervening driver-work records. Verification: flutter analyze passed; all 249 Flutter tests passed with the bundled Python 3.13 runtime; 605 bundled Python tests passed with two fixture-dependent skips; the Ubuntu 20.04 ABI check passed with maximum GLIBC 2.18; DEB, RPM, and Pacman metadata and embedded version 1.0.70 were verified; DEB and AppImage Xvfb smoke tests passed; the AppImage launched under host Wayland and X11; package payloads include the changed drivers and bridge code and omit GLVND/EGL/GLES loaders; all public downloads returned HTTP 200; and the Linux platform manifest reports 1.0.70.
